bins.label: Genre
bins.help: The one genre this song most is. Add a second below only if it is a genuine fusion.

bins.label: Fusion / second style
bins.help: Blend a second style in. Two is usually plenty; more turns into mush.

bins.label: Regional feel
bins.help: Where it sounds like it comes from. Useful shorthand, but the model reads it loosely.

bins.label: Scene / setting
bins.help: The situation the song belongs to. These read strongly in a tag prompt.

bins.label: Tempo
bins.help: The number goes to metadata.bpm, NOT into the caption: ACE-Step's own guide says tempo, key and time signature belong in the metadata parameters and should not be written into the caption. Only a descriptor word reaches the tag string, and only if you pick one. The model anchors near the value rather than hitting it exactly.

bins.label: Time signature
bins.help: Metadata only, never a caption tag. ACE-Step 1.5 accepts 2, 3, 4 or 6; 4/4 is by far the most reliable, 3/4 and 6/8 are usually fine, and 5/4 or 7/8 are unreliable and should be routed to a different generator.

options.caution: Unreliable on ACE-Step 1.5; sparse training data. Route to another generator or expect to measure a mismatch.
Unreliable on ACE-Step 1.5; sparse training data. Route to another generator or expect to measure a mismatch.

bins.label: Key and mode
bins.help: Metadata only, never a caption tag. Common keys (C, G, D, Am, Em) are stable; rare keys are sometimes ignored or shifted, so the measurement is the verdict.

bins.label: Lead vocal
bins.help: Selecting Instrumental clears every other vocal bin.

bins.label: Timbre texture
bins.help: Texture adjectives. ACE-Step's guide lists these as one of the nine canonical caption dimensions, and notes they influence mixing and timbre tendencies.

bins.label: Mood
bins.help: Scored one axis at a time by the compliance battery, so pick the few that matter rather than everything that applies.

bins.label: Song structure
bins.help: A template for the composer to instantiate with timings; the section map itself lives in composition.json.

bins.label: Vibe / free description
bins.help: The escape hatch. Pick the closest tag or type your own when nothing in the lists fits.

bins.label: Content exclusions
bins.help: These do not go into the positive tag string; they become checks and negative conditioning.
